description: Read-only shortcut for recent native XGR value transfers from the Explorer transaction index. Native value transfer means transactions.value > minValueWei and does not include gas fees.

from.description: Sender address or lower bound used for the query.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

minValueWei.description: Value for the min value wei parameter.

page.description: One-based page number for paginated explorer/API results.

to.description: Recipient address, contract address or upper bound used for the query.

windowHours.description: Value for the window hours parameter.

name: get_recent_value_transfers

data.description: Structured result data returned by the XGR MCP gateway.

title: Get recent value transfers
